calls.title: Starttech Ventures + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Christian Liebenow (GrowthBook sales) spoke with Aristeidis Kypriotis (Marketing & Web Analytics at Startech Ventures, a venture builder studio) about replacing the deprecated Google Optimize with GrowthBook for A/B testing across multiple portfolio startups. Key pain points included the high cost of alternatives like Optimizely/VWO, and the need for Bayesian statistics, Google Analytics integration, and cost-effective multi-company management. Next steps: Christian will email documentation
